_comment: slug → cover query (string) OR a list of per-slide queries in slide order (cover first). A list produces <slug>-01.jpg … matching each slide's own argument; a string produces <slug>-cover.jpg. Aim each query at the framework's real subject, not generic business stock — the picture has to look like the thing the slide is talking about.
